critical_code_review_comments: In GrowthDirector.jsx the data-testid 'gos-rec-merged-<id>' is attached to the 'N variants merged' pill (merged_variants count), not to the 'merged into initiative' status pill. Spec language could confuse future testers; consider renaming or adding a dedicated status data-testid like gos-rec-status-pill-<id>.
